children: Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) and Ambuja Neotia have announced the opening of AltAir House – IHCL SeleQtions in Kolkata and Siliguri. The announcement also marks a strengthening of the companies' partnership, with Ambuja Neotia committing Rs 2,700 crore towards West Bengal's hospitality sector across IHCL's brand portfolio in Kolkata, Raichak, Digha, Siliguri, Lataguri, Kalimpong and Darjeeling.
The investment includes the two newly opened hotels and a Rs 100 crore expansion of Taj Chia Kutir Resort & Spa, Darjeeling, which will add 28 keys and 15,000 sq ft of banqueting facilities.

Puneet Chhatwal, Managing Director and CEO, IHCL, said, “Our longstanding partnership with Ambuja Neotia strengthens with the opening of AltAir House under the IHCL SeleQtions brand in Kolkata and Siliguri. AltAir House, with its bespoke design and experiences, is an ideal fit for the IHCL SeleQtions platform. Launched under a franchise arrangement, these openings mark a new chapter in our journey.”
He added, “Rooted in a shared vision, IHCL and Ambuja Neotia are committed to advancing tourism, creating new travel experiences, and expanding the presence of IHCL’s brands across the region.”

Harshavardhan Neotia, Chairman, Ambuja Neotia Group, said, “Bengal offers an extraordinary diversity of landscapes and cultural experiences, from its vibrant cities and riverfronts to its forests, tea gardens and the Himalayas. Our investment commitment of about Rs 2,700 crore reflects our confidence in the region’s tourism potential and our aspiration to create destinations that people will want to experience and revisit.”

He added, “Our association with IHCL has grown over the years through a shared appreciation for thoughtful hospitality. With the launch of AltAir House – IHCL SeleQtions, we aim to create a more individual expression with every hotel telling its own design story, offering distinctive dining experiences and inviting spaces for people to come together. Alongside the continued growth of our Kutir series with IHCL, this marks an important milestone in our partnership.”

Building on the legacy of AltAir in Salt Lake Sector V, Kolkata, a destination for hospitality, dining and leisure for nearly a decade, AltAir House – IHCL SeleQtions debuts as a design-led boutique hospitality offering. Each property is envisioned to tell its own story through architecture, art and design, complemented by curated culinary experiences, signature dining concepts and spaces for gatherings and celebrations.

Located at Ecospace Business Park, New Town, AltAir House – IHCL SeleQtions, Kolkata, features 42 individually designed rooms and suites inspired by Bengal's cultural heritage. The hotel also offers art-led interiors, curated dining and lounge experiences, wellness facilities and spaces for celebrations. The Siliguri property, located within Uttorayon Township, offers 60 rooms and suites inspired by the region's cultural diversity, along with curated dining and indoor and outdoor event spaces that can accommodate up to 1,200 guests.

IHCL and Ambuja Neotia's upcoming projects in West Bengal include Taj Ananta Kutir and Taj Uvanta Signature Residences in Kolkata; Taj Himya Kutir and Taj Himya Branded Villas in Darjeeling; Taj Terai Kutir in Siliguri; Taj Vanya Kutir in Lataguri; AltAir House – IHCL SeleQtions properties in Raichak, Kalimpong, Digha and Lataguri; and Tree of Life in Siliguri.
The partnership currently comprises a portfolio of over 80 properties across India, including 55 resorts under Tree of Life, IHCL's experiential leisure brand.
